features: All-Purpose Kids Drinking Cups – Ideal for kids at home or on the go, these kids straw cups come with reusable BPA-free silicone drink straws and snap-tight, spill proof lids to make it easier to enjoy water, juice,smoothie, milk, hot cocoa,and more

Double-Wall Insulated Steel – Housavvy spill proof straw cups for toddlers retain temperatures far longer than plastic sippy cups which keeps beverages hotter or colder hours longer which improves taste and overall drink quality, important for distracted kids

Super Cute Cup Designs – These small 10-oz. stainless steel tumblers for kids come with three different cup design options on the outside including a traditional blank surface, adorable little dunk, or bouncing bunny. Perfect for boys and girls

Flexible, Reusable Silicone Straws – Each 10-oz. kids cups with handle set also come with 4 colorful smoothie drinking straws that are soft, flexible, and wider to support all kinds of delicious beverages including smoothies, milkshakes, and boba

Clear Tritan Plastic Lids – Our premium stainless steel baby straw sippy cups also come with a transparent lid with a flip-down closure to keep liquids from spilling out and make it easier for kids to enjoy a quick sip with less effort

Lifetime Warranty – Per package includes 4pcs stainless steel kids cups,4pcs kids smoothie silicone straws and 4pcs easy cleaning tritan lids .Housavvy promises to supply the best sippy cups for toddlers with lifetime warranty because we want you to feel 100% confident with your toddler smoothie cups purchase
